description: Set rigid placement by opaque part_id (translation mm, intrinsic XYZ Euler degrees). One assembly undo step. A vault path or display name is unknown_part. Working copy only.

part_id.description: Part id from parts. Not a vault path.

position.description: Translation [x, y, z] in mm. Omitted keeps the current translation.

rotation.description: Intrinsic XYZ Euler rotation in degrees (same order as three.js Euler XYZ). Omitted keeps the current rotation.

name: part_set_transform
